title: CLAUDE.md — vscode.tutorials
text: Build topic sections linked exercise units. typical path: Download load data document source. Inspect printed tibble, summary(), count(), glimpse() (avoid glimpse() wide datasets — prints one line per column). Notice problem opportunity: many categories, missing values, outliers, awkward variable names, important subgroup, unclear plot. Ask AI refine analysis. Make rough plot table. Improve labels, grouping, ordering, scale, caption, visual polish. Add short interpretation paragraph plot table shows. final artifact published page meaningful result world, just completed worksheet.

title: CLAUDE.md — vscode.tutorials
text: Test chunk output scannable seconds. scrolls, long. Apply fixes committing: Wide tibbles (many columns) — glimpse() prints one line per column; 79-column dataset 81 lines. Print tibble directly instead (billboard, glimpse(billboard)): tibbles auto-truncate 10 rows summarise extra columns one line. Reserve glimpse() narrow datasets (≤ ~15 columns) column--column view genuinely useful. CSV column-spec messages — read_csv() prints column-spec block (one line per column) tibble. Suppress show_col_types = FALSE: Long model computation output — wrap suppressMessages() redirect progress refresh = 0, silent = 2 (brms). show final object students need check. Plots — always fine; produce single visual, scrolling text. rule thumb: rendered test chunk output taller laptop screen, shorten .

title: Tutorials for Learning VS Code in GitHub Codespaces
text: core tutorials introduce students VS Code integrated development environment. VS Code Scripts (“01-code”). Introduce students VS Code writing R code simple scripts. VS Code Quarto (“02-quarto”). Demonstrate tricks working R code using VS Code, also explain Quarto documents. Terminal (“03-terminal”). Teach command line. VS Code GitHub Introduction (“04-github-1”). Explain basics Git GitHub, mostly context VS Code. VS Code GitHub Advanced (“05-github-2”). Provide practice working Git/GitHub, including details use GitHub Pages. Quarto Websites Introduction (“06-websites-1”). Demonstrate basics website construction using Quarto projects. Quarto Websites Advanced (“07-websites-2”). Practice Quarto websites, focus splitting data analysis tasks separate files.
